content: HPCToolkit (Tallent & Mellor-Crummey, PPoPP 2010): lock contention from stack samples without ownership data uses blame-shifting; glibc __lll_lock_wait is only reached on the contended futex slow path (never on uncontended fast-path CAS), making it the soundest single-leaf contention signal. Multiple threads at the same lock-acquisition site is probabilistic evidence of above-typical residence time, never proof of who holds it.
